source_map: Ohtsuki Conjecture 3.22, map (30); map (29) at A(t)=1
accepted_claims: Ohtsuki Conjecture 3.22 is false: Patureau-Mirand, Theorem 4 (2012), gives a nonzero kernel element for the exact Laurent-polynomial hair map (30).
The same exact Laurent case is map (29) at the admissible choice A(t)=1. No nontrivial localization is needed to refute the stated conjecture.

The published finite connected witness has first Betti number 17 and Ohtsuki loop-degree 16. Its nonzero source class is separated by cohomological content; all hair-image coefficients vanish by the same local gluing argument.
not_claimed: A new counterexample, theorem, proof novelty or priority.
A self-contained reconstruction of Vogel's zero divisor, a graph weight-system evaluation from first principles, or an independently reproduced graph-reduction/computer certificate.
Noninjectivity for every separate nontrivial localization Q[t,t^-1,1/A(t)], or nonzero survival of the witness in each such localization.
Two knots with identical Kontsevich invariants, or realization of every diagrammatic kernel element by knot invariants.

original_problem_status: Resolved negatively by the credited 2012 published theorem for the exact stated Laurent case; every separate nontrivial localization is outside this acceptance.
